comments: COMMENT ON TABLE "napi_entities"."accounts" IS 'Accounts'' native schema'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "napi_entities"."accounts"."display name" IS 'The user''s display name'
app.Account.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."accounts" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "display name" varchar NOT NULL, "note" varchar, "version" integer NOT NULL, "mood" napi_entities.mood NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Auction.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_listings"."auctions" ( "listing_id" integer NOT NULL, "reserve" integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("listing_id") )

app.Label.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_shipments"."labels" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "text" varchar NOT NULL, "packet_id" integer, "pallet_id" integer, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "fk-labels-packet_id" FOREIGN KEY ("packet_id") REFERENCES "napi_shipments"."packets" ("shipment_id"), CONSTRAINT "fk-labels-pallet_id" FOREIGN KEY ("pallet_id") REFERENCES "napi_shipments"."pallets" ("id") )

app.Listing.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_listings"."listings" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "title" varchar NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Membership.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."memberships" ( "account_id" integer NOT NULL, "team" varchar NOT NULL, "role" varchar NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk-memberships" PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "team") )

app.Note.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."notes" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "account_id" integer NOT NULL, "body" varchar NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "fk-notes-account_id" FOREIGN KEY ("account_id") REFERENCES "napi_entities"."accounts" ("id") )

app.Packet.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_shipments"."packets" ( "shipment_id" integer NOT NULL, "weight_g" integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("shipment_id") )

app.Pallet.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_shipments"."pallets" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "volume_l" smallint NOT NULL, "fragile" bool, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Parcel.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."parcels" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "qty" napi_entities.quantity NOT NULL, "mood" napi_entities.temper NOT NULL, "codes" napi_entities.code[] NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Sale.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_listings"."sales" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "price" integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Shipment.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_shipments"."shipments" ( "id" serial NOT NULL, "kind" napi_shipments.shipment_kind NOT NULL, "label" varchar NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Till.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."tills" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "takings" money NOT NULL, "floats" money[], PRIMARY KEY ("id") )
